verdict.rationale: Pomelo's guides list a first-party capability to escalate fraud and dispute claims with the card networks, so the product does have its own disputes feature. Nothing shows it is exposed programmatically or how deep it goes. The 3DS webhook and refund/reversal adjustments are separate features and do not count here. Missing for 10: a documented disputes API for filing and tracking, network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, dispute status webhooks through resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Escala los reclamos por fraude y controversia con las marcas.
